QuestInfo.name: Maple World and Mirror World
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2400000##k told the duo that this world is actually a fake, based on a place called Maple World. Perhaps she can explain more...
QuestInfo.1: #p2400000# says that Mirror World was created to be your prison. It's just a copy of Maple World. So, what's Maple World? Try to get there through #b#m320000100##k.
QuestInfo.2: As #p2400000# mentioned, Maple World doesn't seem all that different from Mirror World, but the Goddess Teardrops can only be found in Maple World. You must find the teardrops and become the new Transcendent of Time.

0.0: You opened the door to Maple World. You'll see that the portal on your right is activated. Use that portal to go straight to Maple World.
0.1: Take the #b#m320000100##k to Maple World and see for yourself. Mirror World is nothing but a prison.

yes.0: Your link to this world is strong enough to return you at any time. Use the #bTemple Recall#k skill, and you will be instantly transported here.

default.0: You can access Maple World through #b#m320000100##k.
